feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 6 September 2026 11:14am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 06 September 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low to the northwest of the British Isles, with various fronts affecting the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South 5 or 6, but 3 to 5 in the southeast of the area. Veering west or southwest 4 or 5 in all waters early in the night.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, but remaining slight in the southeast of the area, becoming slight in all waters later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain for a time this evening and overnight.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 tomorrow afternoon, occasionally 7 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate, perhaps occasionally rough later.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then rain for a time, becoming fair again later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
